literal_meaning: কথা (talk) চালাচালি (chit-chat or casual exchange) করা (to do)
figurative_meaning_en: To engage in conversation or discussion
example_sentences_in_bangla: তারা বাজারে গিয়ে কথা চালাচালি করছিল।
পার্টিতে সবাই কথা চালাচালি করে সময় কাটাল।
example_sentences_in_english: They were engaging in conversation at the market.
Everyone chatted away at the party to pass the time.
note: This idiom reflects everyday Bengali social norms of informal talking.
